caseTitle.en: The skin lab: a head chef's hands

condition.zh: 乾癬 · 手掌乾癬與關節

title.en: Dermatology: a day in the skin lab

tagline.zh: 先刮一刮再下診斷；面積小，不等於輕
tagline.en: Scrape before you name it; a small area is not a mild disease

desc.zh: 刮皮屑、看皮膚鏡、選切片的位置、問一個皮膚科常忘記問的問題：「你的關節呢？」
desc.en: Take skin scrapings, use the dermatoscope, choose a biopsy site, and ask the question dermatology often forgets: 'And your joints?'

desc.zh: 做 KOH 檢查、在顯微鏡下找菌絲、種黴菌培養、準備切片器械。陰性和陽性，你都要說得出意思。
desc.en: Run the KOH preparations, hunt for hyphae under the microscope, plate fungal cultures, set out the biopsy tray. You must be able to say what a negative means as well as a positive.

about.zh: 愛吃熱炒的皮膚科主治，診間抽屜裡有一把刀片和一包花生。口頭禪：「先刮一刮，再下診斷。」
about.en: A dermatologist who loves stir-fry restaurants and keeps a scalpel blade and a bag of peanuts in his desk drawer. Catchphrase: 'Scrape first, name it second.'

about.zh: 看 KOH 片子看了十五年，說菌絲在顯微鏡下「像一條沒煮熟的冬粉」。
about.en: Fifteen years of KOH slides; says hyphae under the microscope look 'like an undercooked glass noodle'.

about.zh: 45 歲熱炒店主廚，雙手掌心厚皮、裂開、會流血，握炒鍋會痛。診所說是「富貴手」，叫他少洗手。廚房一天要洗手上百次。（虛擬個案）
about.en: Forty-five, head chef at a stir-fry restaurant. Thick, cracked palms that bleed; gripping the wok hurts. His clinic called it 'housework hands' and told him to wash less. A kitchen washes its hands a hundred times a day. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 大學生，週末在店裡幫忙出菜。爸爸不講的事，她都講。
about.en: A university student who helps serve at the restaurant on weekends. Whatever her father won't say, she does.

role.en: Aged 8 · a ring on the arm

about.zh: 8 歲，上個月撿了一隻小貓。手臂上一個會癢、邊緣紅、中間比較淡的圈圈，越來越大。（虛擬個案）
about.en: Eight, adopted a kitten last month. An itchy ring on his forearm, red at the edge and paler in the middle, getting bigger. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 很怕是「會傳染的皮膚病」，也很怕要把小貓送走。
about.en: Afraid it is 'a contagious skin disease', and just as afraid they will have to give up the kitten.

about.zh: 皮膚科轉來疑似乾癬性關節炎，會盡量排快一點的門診。
about.en: When dermatology refers a possible psoriatic arthritis, finds the earliest clinic slot it can.

plain.zh: 免疫系統讓皮膚細胞長得太快，形成邊界清楚、上面有銀白色厚屑的紅色斑塊。不會傳染，常常跟關節、心血管、代謝問題有關。
plain.en: The immune system makes skin cells grow too fast, forming well-defined red plaques with thick silvery scale. Not contagious, and often linked with joint, heart and metabolic problems.

plain.zh: 長在手掌腳掌的乾癬，面積很小卻會裂、會痛、會流血，影響工作的程度常常比大面積的還大。
plain.en: Psoriasis on the palms and soles. The area is small, but it cracks, hurts and bleeds, and often disrupts work more than widespread disease.

plain.zh: 乾癬病人的一種發炎性關節炎：手指末端關節、整根手指腫、腳跟痛、早上僵硬。拖久會造成關節破壞，所以要早點找風濕科。
plain.en: An inflammatory arthritis in people with psoriasis: the end finger joints, a whole swollen finger, heel pain, morning stiffness. Left too long it damages joints, so rheumatology is involved early.

plain.zh: 指甲表面像頂針一樣的小凹洞。乾癬的指甲變化，常常提醒要問關節。
plain.en: Tiny pits in the nail surface, like a thimble. A psoriatic nail change that is a reminder to ask about the joints.

plain.zh: 整根手指或腳趾腫得像香腸。是乾癬性關節炎很有意義的表現。
plain.en: A whole finger or toe swollen like a sausage. A meaningful sign of psoriatic arthritis.

plain.zh: 把皮屑放在玻片上，滴氫氧化鉀溶解角質，在顯微鏡下找黴菌的菌絲。幾分鐘就有答案，陰性卻不能完全排除。
plain.en: Skin scale on a slide with potassium hydroxide to dissolve the keratin, then the microscope to look for fungal hyphae. An answer within minutes, though a negative does not fully exclude fungus.

plain.zh: 黴菌長出來的細長分枝絲狀構造。在 KOH 片子上看到，就支持是黴菌感染。
plain.en: The long, branching threads a fungus grows. Seen on a KOH slide, they support a fungal infection.

plain.zh: 身體皮膚的黴菌感染，像一個邊緣紅、會往外擴大的圈圈。常從寵物或其他人身上傳來，擦對藥就會好。
plain.en: A fungal infection of body skin, like a ring with a red edge that spreads outwards. Often caught from pets or people, and cleared with the right cream.

plain.zh: 皮膚屏障受損加上發炎，癢、紅、脫屑、裂。手部濕疹跟手掌乾癬有時候很難分，需要刮屑、看分布，必要時切片。
plain.en: A damaged skin barrier plus inflammation: itch, redness, scaling, cracks. Hand eczema and palmar psoriasis can be hard to tell apart and may need scrapings, the pattern, and sometimes a biopsy.

plain.zh: 取一小塊皮膚給病理科看。選的位置很重要：有代表性、不在感染或剛抓破的地方。
plain.en: A small piece of skin sent to pathology. Choosing the site matters: representative, and not infected or freshly scratched.

plain.zh: 修補皮膚屏障的乳霜或油膏。洗手後馬上擦，是手部皮膚病的基本功。
plain.en: A cream or ointment that repairs the skin barrier. Applied straight after washing, it is the foundation of treating hand skin disease.

plain.zh: 在醫院用特定波長的紫外線照皮膚，減少發炎。對擦藥效果不好的手掌乾癬是一個選項。
plain.en: Specific wavelengths of ultraviolet light given in hospital to calm the inflammation. An option for palmar psoriasis that has not responded to creams.

text.zh: 皮膚科檢驗室的主角。KOH 片子先低倍掃、再高倍確認。阿瑩說：菌絲會穿過細胞邊界，皮膚的紋路不會。
text.en: The star of the skin lab. KOH slides are scanned at low power, confirmed at high. Ying's rule: hyphae cross cell borders; skin markings never do.

text.zh: 加光源的放大鏡。看乾癬的規則點狀血管、看指甲凹陷、看黴菌的斷髮，都比肉眼清楚。
text.en: A magnifier with its own light. Psoriasis's regular dotted vessels, nail pits, the broken hairs of fungus: all clearer than with the naked eye.

text.zh: 環鑽、鑷子、小剪刀、縫線、標本瓶。標本瓶上寫病人、部位、日期，申請單寫清楚想問病理什麼。
text.en: Punch, forceps, small scissors, sutures, specimen pot. The pot is labelled with patient, site and date, and the request form says clearly what you want pathology to answer.

text.zh: 皮屑種下去，要等好幾週才知道是哪一種黴菌。KOH 回答「有沒有」，培養回答「是誰」。
text.en: Scrapings plated here take weeks to show which fungus it is. KOH answers 'is there any'; culture answers 'who is it'.

name.en: Chef Wan's two layers of gloves

text.zh: 裡面一雙棉手套、外面一雙丁腈手套，是小晴在檢驗室幫爸爸剪好、試戴的。她在棉手套上用麥克筆寫了「主廚」。
text.en: A cotton liner inside a nitrile glove, which Qing trimmed and fitted for her father right there in the lab. On the cotton one she wrote 'CHEF' in marker pen.

text.zh: 會脫屑的紅斑，可能是乾癬、濕疹，也可能是黴菌。黴菌如果被當成濕疹擦類固醇，會變得更難認。KOH 只要幾分鐘：陽性就支持黴菌；陰性不能完全排除，必要時培養或切片。小柏的圈圈和阿萬師的手掌，今天都從同一個動作開始。
text.en: A scaly red rash may be psoriasis, eczema, or fungus. Fungus treated as eczema with steroid creams becomes harder to recognise. KOH takes minutes: positive supports fungus; negative does not fully exclude it, so culture or biopsy when needed. Bo's ring and Chef Wan's palms both began today with the same action.

text.zh: 乾癬的嚴重度不只看體表面積，也看部位和生活：手掌、腳掌、臉、生殖部位、指甲，即使很小也可能讓人不能工作、不能睡。評估時要問工作、疼痛、睡眠、心情，治療選擇也要配合現實：一天洗手上百次的人，白天擦的藥一定被洗掉。
text.en: Psoriasis severity is not just body-surface area; it is site and life. Palms, soles, face, genitals and nails can stop someone working or sleeping even when tiny. Ask about work, pain, sleep and mood, and fit the treatment to reality: someone who washes a hundred times a day will wash off any daytime cream.

text.zh: 相當比例的乾癬病人會發生乾癬性關節炎，而且皮膚科常是第一個看到他們的科。每一次都問：早上手指僵多久、有沒有整根手指腫、腳跟痛不痛、指甲有沒有凹陷。早一點轉風濕科，關節破壞就少一點。
text.en: A substantial share of people with psoriasis develop psoriatic arthritis, and dermatology is often the first specialty to see them. Ask every time: how long are the fingers stiff in the morning, any whole swollen finger, any heel pain, any nail pits. The earlier rheumatology is involved, the less joint damage.

note.en: The order of a KOH prep

lines.zh: 阿瑩。早上兩個要刮的：一個小朋友手上的圈圈，一個大廚的手掌。先把 KOH 的順序講一遍。
lines.en: Ying. Two scrapings this morning: a child with a ring on his arm, and a chef's palms. First, talk me through the KOH order.

lines.zh: 彭主治。皮膚科有一句老話：先刮一刮，再下診斷。今天兩個病人，都從這一句開始。
lines.en: Dr Peng. Dermatology has an old saying: scrape first, name it second. Both of today's patients start there.

q.en: KOH preparation: put the steps in order

steps.en: Check the patient and the site

steps.zh: 在病灶活動邊緣刮皮屑
steps.en: Scrape scale from the active edge
Scale on a slide; add KOH

steps.zh: 蓋上蓋玻片，等角質溶解
steps.en: Coverslip; wait for the keratin to clear

steps.zh: 顯微鏡低倍掃、高倍確認菌絲
steps.en: Microscope: scan low, confirm hyphae high

steps.zh: 回報：陰性不能完全排除
steps.en: Report: a negative does not fully exclude

post.zh: 對。刮邊緣，不是刮中間；中間常常已經沒有菌了。
post.en: Right. Scrape the edge, not the middle; the middle often has no fungus left.

guide.en: Find the microscope and switch on

lines.zh: 顯微鏡開燈、光圈調小一點，KOH 片子對比太亮會看不到菌絲。
lines.en: Microscope on, close the condenser down a little; with too much light you'll never see hyphae on a KOH slide.

q.zh: 找到檢驗室的顯微鏡，準備看 KOH 片子
q.en: Find the lab microscope and get ready for KOH slides

post.zh: 好了。小朋友來了，他手上那隻貓的照片比他的圈圈還多。
post.en: Ready. Here comes the child; he's got more photos of his kitten than of his ring.

note.zh: KOH 陽性：體癬，貓不用送走
note.en: KOH positive: tinea, and the kitten stays

lines.zh: 醫師，是不是會傳染的皮膚病？小貓是不是要送走？他哭了一整晚。
lines.en: Doctor, is it a contagious skin disease? Do we have to give the kitten away? He cried all night.

lines.zh: 小柏，我用刀片的背面刮一刮圈圈的邊，不會痛，像在削鉛筆屑。
lines.en: Bo, I'll scrape the edge of the ring with the back of a blade. It won't hurt; it's like pencil shavings.

lines.zh: 來看：一條一條、有分枝、穿過細胞邊界的線。像沒煮熟的冬粉。
lines.en: Look: long branching threads crossing the cell borders. Like undercooked glass noodles.

lines.zh: 這是菌絲。小柏的圈圈是體癬，黴菌，大概是小貓給的。擦對的藥就會好。
lines.en: Those are hyphae. Bo's ring is tinea corporis, a fungus, probably from the kitten. The right cream will clear it.

lines.zh: 小貓不用送走，帶去給獸醫看，牠也要治療。毛巾、貓窩洗一洗。
lines.en: The kitten stays; take it to the vet, because it needs treating too. Wash the towels and the cat bed.

lines.zh: 耶！牠叫麻糬。
lines.en: Yes! Her name's Mochi.

note.zh: KOH 陰性；面積小卻不能工作
note.en: KOH negative; a small area that stops work

lines.zh: 診所說是富貴手，叫我少洗手。我是廚師，一天洗一百次，少洗怎麼可能？握炒鍋的時候裂開會流血。
lines.en: The clinic said it's housework hands and told me to wash less. I'm a chef: a hundred washes a day. Wash less? When I grip the wok the cracks bleed.

lines.zh: 兩邊掌心都是邊界很清楚的厚斑塊，上面有厚屑和裂口。KOH 刮過了，沒有看到菌絲。
lines.en: Well-defined thick plaques on both palms, heavy scale, fissures. I've done a KOH: no hyphae.

lines.zh: 面積這麼小，算輕症嗎？先回答這題，再告訴我你怎麼想。
lines.en: An area this small: is it mild? Answer this first, then tell me what you think.

post.zh: 嚴重度要看部位和生活。手掌、天天要用、會痛會流血、影響工作，就不是輕症。
post.en: Severity depends on site and life. Palms, used all day, painful and bleeding, stopping his work: that is not mild.

post.zh: 他上禮拜炒到一半，把鍋鏟丟在地上，跑去後面冰手。他不會跟你說的。
post.en: Last week, mid-stir-fry, he threw the spatula down and went out the back to put his hands on ice. He won't tell you that.

lines.zh: 阿萬師的右手中指比其他手指粗一圈，好幾片指甲表面有小凹洞。
lines.en: Chef Wan's right middle finger is noticeably thicker than the others, and several nails are dotted with tiny pits.

q.zh: 手掌斑塊、指甲凹陷、一根手指比較粗。接下來你要問什麼？
q.en: Palm plaques, nail pits, one thicker finger. What do you ask next?

options.zh: 問晨僵、手指腫、腳跟痛：關節
options.en: Morning stiffness, swollen fingers, heel pain: the joints

why.zh: 指甲凹陷和整根手指腫，是乾癬性關節炎的重要線索。皮膚科常是第一個看到的科，早問、早轉風濕科，關節破壞就少一點。
why.en: Nail pits and a whole swollen finger are important clues to psoriatic arthritis. Dermatology is often first to see it; ask early, refer early, and the joints come off better.

options.en: Small area; an ointment will do

why.zh: 藥膏也許會讓手掌好一點，卻不會告訴你他的關節正在發炎。
why.en: An ointment may help the palms, but it will never tell you his joints are inflamed.

options.zh: 建議他換一份不用洗手的工作

why.zh: 治療要配合他的生活，不是叫他放棄生活。而且這個建議，跳過了最重要的問題。
why.en: Treatment fits his life; it does not ask him to give it up. And the suggestion skips the most important question.

post.zh: 早上手指要動半天才開得了店門。中指腫兩個月了，我以為是剁排骨剁的。
post.en: In the morning it takes ages before my fingers work well enough to unlock the shop. The middle finger has been swollen two months; I thought it was from chopping ribs.

name.en: A biopsy and a dizzy spell

note.zh: 選對位置；主廚怕自己的血
note.en: The right site; a chef afraid of his own blood

guide.zh: 用皮膚鏡看指甲和斑塊

lines.zh: 切之前，先用皮膚鏡看。指甲和斑塊上的血管，都會說話。
lines.en: Before cutting, use the dermatoscope. The nails and the vessels in the plaques both have something to say.

lines.zh: 好幾片指甲有頂針一樣的小洞，是指甲凹陷。斑塊上是規則分布的點狀血管，比較像乾癬。
lines.en: Several nails have thimble-like pits: nail pitting. The plaques show evenly spread dotted vessels, more like psoriasis.

lines.zh: 皮膚鏡支持乾癬。做一個小小的皮膚切片，讓我們更確定，也排除濕疹和其他診斷。
lines.en: Dermoscopy supports psoriasis. A small skin biopsy will make us surer, and exclude eczema and other diagnoses.

lines.zh: 切片……會流血嗎？我先說，我不太行。
lines.en: A biopsy... will it bleed? I'll say it now: I'm not great with that.

guide.en: Choose and mark the biopsy site

lines.zh: 手掌的乾癬和濕疹有時候長得很像。切一小塊確定。位置怎麼選？不要選剛裂開流血的地方。
lines.en: Palmar psoriasis and eczema can look very alike. A small biopsy will settle it. How do you choose the site? Not a fresh, bleeding fissure.

post.zh: 選手腕附近一塊典型、沒有裂開、不在握鍋位置的斑塊，邊緣標好了。
post.en: A typical plaque near the wrist, not fissured, away from where he grips the wok. Margins marked.

lines.zh: 局部麻醉的針一進去，阿萬師看到一滴血，臉色刷白，額頭冒汗，說眼前發黑。
lines.en: As the local anaesthetic needle goes in, Chef Wan sees a drop of blood, turns white, sweats and says everything is going dark.

lines.zh: 我每天剁豬頭……可是自己的血不行……
lines.en: I chop pigs' heads every day... but my own blood, no...

options.zh: 停下、放平、抬腳、量脈搏血壓、叫人
options.en: Stop, lay him flat, raise his legs, check pulse and pressure, call for help

why.zh: 最像血管迷走神經反應：心跳變慢、血壓下降。先停處置、放平抬腳、監測，通常很快恢復；恢復後再決定要不要繼續。
why.en: Most likely a vasovagal reaction: slow pulse, falling pressure. Stop the procedure, lay him flat with legs raised, monitor; recovery is usually quick, and then decide whether to continue.

options.zh: 叫他坐起來深呼吸，快點做完
options.en: Sit him up, deep breaths, finish quickly

why.zh: 血壓在掉的時候坐起來，會真的昏倒，可能從床上摔下來。
why.en: Sitting up while the pressure is falling leads to a real faint, maybe off the couch.

options.zh: 是麻藥過敏，馬上打過敏的藥
options.en: It's an anaesthetic allergy; give allergy drugs now

why.zh: 沒有紅疹、喘或嘴唇腫，又是看到血就發作，比較像血管迷走反應。先處理最可能的，再看有沒有過敏的徵象。
why.en: No rash, wheeze or swollen lips, and it came on at the sight of blood: far more like a vasovagal reaction. Treat the likely cause first, while watching for signs of allergy.

post.zh: 我們不說。切片做好了，標本瓶寫好部位，你都沒看到血。
post.en: We won't. The biopsy's done, the pot is labelled with the site, and you never saw a drop.

guide.zh: 看阿萬師的手部 X 光

lines.zh: 家醫科去年幫他照過手的 X 光，說是「退化」。重新看一次，這次帶著乾癬的眼睛。
lines.en: His GP X-rayed his hands last year and called it 'wear and tear'. Look again, this time with psoriasis in mind.

question.zh: 有乾癬、指甲凹陷、中指整根腫的人，手部 X 光要找什麼？為什麼不是「退化」就結束？
question.en: In someone with psoriasis, nail pits and a whole swollen middle finger, what do you look for on hand X-rays? Why not just stop at 'wear and tear'?

answer.zh: 找乾癬性關節炎的變化：手指末端關節的侵蝕、骨頭邊緣的新骨增生、軟組織腫脹，嚴重時關節變形。早期 X 光可能正常，所以臨床症狀比片子更早。退化性關節炎也可能同時存在，但整根手指腫和指甲變化指向發炎，要轉風濕科評估。
answer.en: Changes of psoriatic arthritis: erosions at the end finger joints, fluffy new bone at the bone margins, soft-tissue swelling, and deformity in severe disease. Early films can be normal, so the symptoms come before the X-ray. Wear-and-tear arthritis may coexist, but a sausage finger and nail changes point to inflammation and need rheumatology assessment.

post.zh: 中指整根軟組織腫，末端關節邊緣有一點不規則。不只是退化。
post.en: Soft-tissue swelling along the whole middle finger, and a little irregularity at the end-joint margins. More than wear and tear.

sub.zh: 疑似乾癬性關節炎，下週門診可以
sub.en: Possible psoriatic arthritis: next week's clinic

lines.zh: 風濕科。你的轉介寫得很清楚：晨僵、指炎、指甲凹陷、X 光變化。下週一早上給他一個號。
lines.en: Rheumatology. Your referral is very clear: morning stiffness, dactylitis, nail pits, X-ray changes. Monday morning next week, he has a slot.

lines.zh: 謝謝。皮膚和關節的治療，有些藥可以一起照顧，到時候一起討論。
lines.en: Thank you. Some treatments cover both skin and joints, so we'll decide together.

sub.zh: 轉介單上沒有關節症狀？
sub.en: No joint symptoms on the referral?

lines.zh: 風濕科。X 光看起來有乾癬性關節炎的變化，但轉介單上沒寫晨僵、沒寫手指腫。他有沒有症狀？
lines.en: Rheumatology. The X-ray looks like psoriatic arthritis, but the referral doesn't mention morning stiffness or swollen fingers. Does he have symptoms?

lines.zh: 這次是片子先說話了。下一個乾癬病人，你先問關節，不要等 X 光替你問。
lines.en: This time the film spoke first. With the next psoriasis patient, ask about the joints before an X-ray has to ask for you.

lines.zh: 我現在補問、補寫。中指腫兩個月，早上僵很久。
lines.en: I'm asking and adding it now. Middle finger swollen two months, long morning stiffness.

name.en: A plan that fits the kitchen

note.zh: 一天洗一百次手的人怎麼擦藥
note.en: How to treat hands washed a hundred times a day

guide.en: Plan treatment with Chef Wan and Qing

lines.zh: 藥膏我有擦啊，擦完洗一次手就沒了。廚房不能不洗手吧？
lines.en: I do put the ointment on; one hand-wash and it's gone. A kitchen can't skip hand-washing, can it?

lines.zh: 治療要先過他的廚房這一關。一天洗上百次手的人，白天擦的藥一定被洗掉。那要怎麼辦？
lines.en: Treatment has to survive his kitchen first. Someone washing a hundred times a day will always wash off a daytime cream. So what do we do?

post.zh: 藥膏改成晚上睡前擦，戴棉手套睡。白天洗手後擦保濕劑，工作戴棉手套加丁腈手套。效果不夠，再談照光治療或口服、注射的藥。
post.en: The medicated ointment moves to bedtime, under cotton gloves overnight. By day, emollient after every wash, and at work a cotton liner under a nitrile glove. If that isn't enough, we discuss phototherapy, or tablets or injections.

post.zh: 手套我現在就幫他剪。爸，你中指那裡要剪大一點。
post.en: I'll cut the gloves for him right now. Dad, the middle finger needs a bigger hole.

lines.zh: 小柏的皮屑種在培養皿上，貼好標籤，放培養箱。KOH 告訴我們有沒有，培養告訴我們是誰。
lines.en: Bo's scale goes onto the plate, labelled, into the incubator. KOH told us whether; culture tells us who.

lines.zh: 幾週後如果是貓狗常見的那一種，就跟麻糬的獸醫說一聲。
lines.en: If in a few weeks it's the type cats and dogs carry, we'll let Mochi's vet know.

note.zh: 刮一刮、問關節、配合生活
note.en: Scrape, ask the joints, fit the life

lines.zh: 今天兩個人：一個是黴菌，一個不是。分辨它們的，是同一個刮一刮的動作。
lines.en: Two patients today: one fungus, one not. What told them apart was the same small act of scraping.

lines.zh: 面積小不等於輕；乾癬要問關節；治療要過得了病人的生活。這三件事，你都做到了。
lines.en: A small area is not mild; psoriasis means asking about joints; treatment must survive the patient's life. You managed all three.

lines.zh: 還有一件：病人暈倒的時候，你先放平，沒有先慌。
lines.en: And one more: when the patient fainted, you laid him flat before you panicked.

note.zh: 麻糬也有圈圈；主廚戴著手套炒菜
note.en: Mochi has rings too; the chef cooks in gloves

sub.zh: 柏媽：小貓和哥哥也有圈圈
sub.en: Bo's mother: kitten and brother have rings too

lines.zh: 醫師，不好意思晚上打來。麻糬耳朵旁邊也禿一塊，哥哥脖子也長了一個圈圈。要不要全家去急診？
lines.en: Doctor, sorry to call this late. Mochi has a bald patch by her ear, and Bo's brother has a ring on his neck now. Should the whole family go to the ER?

lines.zh: 不用去急診。這是同一種黴菌，不危險。哥哥明天來刮一下，麻糬帶去獸醫，毛巾、床單、貓窩用熱水洗。
lines.en: No need for the ER. It's the same fungus and it isn't dangerous. Bring his brother in tomorrow for a scrape, take Mochi to the vet, and wash towels, sheets and the cat bed in hot water.

lines.zh: 好。小柏說，麻糬是他的病人，他要負責擦藥。
lines.en: OK. Bo says Mochi is his patient, and he's in charge of her cream.

lines.zh: （傳訊息）醫師，晚上客人很多，爸爸戴著兩層手套炒了三十盤，說今天第一次沒有裂開。
lines.en: (Text message) Doctor, it was busy tonight. Dad cooked thirty plates in two layers of gloves and says it's the first day nothing cracked.

lines.zh: 照片裡那雙手套上寫著「主廚」。下次去吃熱炒，我們要坐最靠廚房的位子。
lines.en: The gloves in the photo say 'CHEF'. Next time we go for stir-fry, we sit nearest the kitchen.

sub.zh: 先刮一刮；面積小不等於輕；記得問關節
sub.en: Scrape first; small is not mild; ask about the joints
